source: S06 Phase 1 bounded sources and visual plan

assets.title: Extract first, then use the folder
assets.alt: Three numbered panels distinguish the ZIP, the extracted package root and the same root opened in VS Code.
assets.caption: Use the extracted folder, not the compressed view. Interface wording can vary by Windows version.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: One folder, two terminals
assets.alt: A diagram shows the package explorer, a server terminal holding READY and a separate client terminal.
assets.caption: Keep the server running while the client sends requests. The sample PORT is a placeholder, not a measured port.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: The query boundary
assets.alt: Six numbered boxes separate request strings, validation, Sequelize options, model call, rows and HTTP representation.
assets.caption: Record the evidence class at each boundary. The call counter supplies different evidence from the HTTP status.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: The four-row fixture and sorts
assets.alt: Fixture panel lists four note IDs, titles, owners and archived flags; sort panel lists three source-expected ID orders.
assets.caption: Compare these source expectations only after preserving your original predictions. Measure the real result separately.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Literal percent and a boolean string
assets.alt: Two numbered panels explain percent URL decoding and the difference between the false string and a boolean.
assets.caption: Reason about the two translations before the request. This diagram explains a rule and contains no translator solution.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Memory and the short file observation
assets.alt: Three panels distinguish the P02 memory database, one-process file connection lifecycle and the recorded boundary.
assets.caption: The short file task is required separately. It does not require the full optional P01 implementation.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Observe the correct browser tab
assets.alt: The correct local application tab is contrasted with guide and external service tabs; the Network request is highlighted.
assets.caption: Browser capture is optional. A CLI HTTP transcript can supply the required HTTP witness without a screenshot.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Draft export, final PDF and inspection
assets.alt: Three numbered panels distinguish the evidence form, recoverable JSON draft and inspected final PDF.
assets.caption: A draft may retain blocks. Standard final mode needs actual required evidence and an honest declaration.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Audit one Gemini claim
assets.alt: Prompt, selected claim with independent check and student verdict form three numbered stages.
assets.caption: Gemini reviews a claim. The task does not request the complete translator, changed tests or new dependencies.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.

assets.title: Check Moodle submission status
assets.alt: Three numbered Moodle panels show assignment title, saving and final submission receipt checks.
assets.caption: Stop if the title is wrong or the status remains Draft. This illustration is not a live Moodle receipt.
assets.source: Locally drawn from the S06 bounded source and Phase 1 specification. No native application or online service was observed.
